description: Change the width of a column in the table or inside a subform/linked_records. Use it when the user asks to make a column wider/narrower, to enlarge/shrink a column in the table view.

entity_id.description: ID of the form whose table changes

field_id.description: ID of the column field whose width changes

subform_field_id.description: If the column changed is INSIDE a subform or linked_records, pass the ID of the subform field (linked_records/subform) here. Without this parameter the column of the main table changes.

name: set_column_size
